title: Scotty P.AI for lawyers and high-ticket businesses
decision: Who to sell AI agents to, how to price them, and how content and the coaching network fit in.
brief: A jujutsu coach already runs social media for a family and criminal lawyer at $1,500 a month. That lawyer is his first AI agent client tomorrow, at $500 a month or more. He wants high-ticket clients, not coaches.

options.label: Prove it on the first lawyer first
Keep the gym and coaching niche

assumptions: A retained client is worth $3,000 to $10,000 to the firm
Lawyer agrees to be the case study
